output.answer_markdown: The Q2 2023 filing material does not show Pfizer spinning off any business segment. The only spin-off it mentions is the Upjohn Business, which was completed earlier [1]. As of Q2 2023, Pfizer managed its commercial operations through two operating segments, Biopharma and Business Innovation [2]. The passages do not say whether a spin-off was planned or pending.

provenance.quote: in November 2020, we and Mylan completed the transaction to spin-off our Upjohn Business and combine it with Mylan to form Viatris

claims.text: In November 2020, Pfizer and Mylan completed the transaction to spin-off Pfizer's Upjohn Business and combine it with Mylan to form Viatris, so this spin-off was already completed before Q2 2023.

provenance.quote: We manage our commercial operations through two operating segments, each led by a single manager: Biopharma and Business Innovation.

claims.text: Pfizer managed its commercial operations through two operating segments, Biopharma and Business Innovation.

found: The Upjohn Business spin-off, combined with Mylan to form Viatris, was completed in November 2020.
As of Q2 2023, Pfizer operated two segments, Biopharma and Business Innovation.
missing: An explicit statement in the Q2 2023 filing about any planned or pending spin-off of a business segment.
refusal.reason: The passages show no pending or announced spin-off of a segment as of Q2 2023, but they contain no explicit statement ruling one out.
